svg.title: A chain of trust ends in a store you configured
svg.desc: The leaf certificate is signed by an intermediate, the intermediate by a root. The root key sits in a trust store on your device; nothing signs it.

text.tspan: Verification walks up. Trust walks down.
Each link is checked with the key in the card above it ...
... until a key you already have.
The self-signature on the root proves nothing: anyone can sign their own card.
